headline: Growth Ambition Remains Intact; Execution Visibility Limited

highlights: Services revenue grew 31% YoY to INR 2.32 Bn, while ROW revenue increased 35% to INR 2.03 Bn, partly offsetting a 37% decline in domestic government-led projects.

The company secured INR 74+ Cr of new orders and renewals during the quarter, including a strategic US partnership in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, an AI-powered service desk engagement and an MIDC connectivity project.

We remain cautiously constructive on the growth outlook, supported by managed services and international traction; however, sustained acceleration hinges on improved large-deal conversion and recovery in government-led project execution.

Margin Recovery Remains Gradual; AI-led Efficiency Yet to Materialise: ALDS reported EBITDA of INR 270 Mn (including other income), with margin at 10%, down 200 bps YoY, reflecting investments in talent, leadership and growth capabilities, competitive pricing and elevated operating cost.
valuation: Source: ALDS,Choice Institutional Equities Growth Ambition Remains Intact; Execution Visibility Limited ALDS Q2FY27 performance reflects improving traction in international markets and recurring services; however, visibility on sustaining the targeted growth trajectory remains limited.
View & Valuation: We have rolled forward our estimate to FY28-29E average EPS, maintained our TP at INR 125 and upgraded our rating to ‘BUY’ following the recent stock correction.

We have, however, moderated our valuation multiple to 10x from 12x, primarily factoring in limited visibility on large government-led project wins and the uncertainty surrounding the pace of achieving the targeted growth trajectory.
watch: We remain cautiously constructive on the growth outlook, supported by managed services and international traction; however, sustained acceleration hinges on improved large-deal conversion and recovery in government-led project execution.

While the management remains confident of achieving the INR 1,000-Cr annual revenue milestone and aspiring for 20% YoY growth, elongated decision cycles for large deals and uncertain conversion of sizeable government projects pose execution risks.
